paragraphs.source_en: At this point, as I crouched there, I began to wonder: would this gentleman burglar go from the kitchen toward the dining room? Or would he turn left, pass through the entrance hall, and make his way into the study? After this gentleman burglar had opened the sliding partition, his footsteps went off toward the veranda. At last he had gone into the study. After that, no sound whatever could be heard.

units.source_en: At this point, as I crouched there, I began to wonder: would this gentleman burglar go from the kitchen toward the dining room?
units.source_zh: 这时，我蹲在那里寻思起来：这位梁上君子是从厨房往餐厅方向去呢？

units.source_en: Or would he turn left, pass through the entrance hall, and make his way into the study?
units.source_zh: 还是折向左，通过门厅进入书斋呢？

units.source_en: After this gentleman burglar had opened the sliding partition, his footsteps went off toward the veranda.
units.source_zh: 这位梁上君子在打开隔扇后，脚步声便向前廊方向而去。

units.source_en: At last he had gone into the study.
units.source_zh: 他终于进到书斋里了。

units.source_en: After that, no sound whatever could be heard.
units.source_zh: 然后就再也听不见什么声响。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这时，我蹲在那里寻思起来：这位梁上君子是从厨房往餐厅方向去呢？还是折向左，通过门厅进入书斋呢？这位梁上君子在打开隔扇后，脚步声便向前廊方向而去。他终于进到书斋里了。然后就再也听不见什么声响。

paragraphs.source_en: Only during this interval did it occur to me that I ought to hurry and wake my master and his wife. But when it came to actually doing it, I could not for the life of me think of a good way to make them wake up. The thought merely spun round and round in my head like a waterwheel, and no plan came to me at all. I thought it might work if I took the edge of the quilt in my mouth and shook it, so I tried two or three times, but it had not the slightest effect. I thought that if I rubbed my cold nose against my master's cheek he might wake, but just as I brought it close to his face, to my surprise he stretched out his arm in his sleep and struck me hard on the muzzle. The nose, you know, is a vital spot for a cat. The pain was simply dreadful. Driven to desperation, I next thought I would wake him by meowing a couple of times. Yet for some reason it was as though something were stuck in my throat, and I could not get a sound out. With great effort I finally managed to squeeze out a low sound or two. But not only did the master, who ought to have awakened, fail to wake; instead the footsteps of this gentleman burglar suddenly began to sound. The creaking from the corridor drew nearer and nearer. I thought, "Here he comes for certain; now there is nothing to be done." So I hid myself between the sliding partition and the wicker trunk, and watched to see what would happen.

units.source_en: Only during this interval did it occur to me that I ought to hurry and wake my master and his wife.

units.source_zh: 但是，真要做起来，怎样才能使他们醒来，我实在想不出好主意。

units.source_zh: 这种想法只是在我的头脑里像水车一般咕噜噜飞快地转个不停，就是想不出主意来。

units.source_en: I thought it might work if I took the edge of the quilt in my mouth and shook it, so I tried two or three times, but it had not the slightest effect.

units.source_en: So I hid myself between the sliding partition and the wicker trunk, and watched to see what would happen.

paragraphs.source_zh: 我在这期间才想到应该赶紧去唤醒主人夫妇。但是，真要做起来，怎样才能使他们醒来，我实在想不出好主意。这种想法只是在我的头脑里像水车一般咕噜噜飞快地转个不停，就是想不出主意来。我想，我叼上被角抖动一下也许会有效果，我试了两三次，结果毫不见效。我想，如果把我的凉鼻子擦一下主人的脸庞，也许他会醒来，可当我刚一凑上前去，想不到主人在睡梦中用劲一伸胳膊，狠狠地击了一下我的鼻头。鼻子可是猫儿的致命地方啊。疼得我简直要命！万般无奈，这回我想喵喵叫上两声来唤醒他。可不知为什么，好像有一种东西哽在我的喉咙里，怎么也叫不出声来。我费了好大力气，总算哼出了一两声。可是不但应该醒来的主人没有醒，反而突然出现了这位梁上君子的脚步声。从廊子里咯吱咯吱的声音愈来愈近。我想：“果真来了哩，已经毫无办法啦。”于是，我躲到隔扇和柳条箱之间，窥伺着动静。

paragraphs.source_en: The gentleman burglar's footsteps came as far as the sliding door of the bedroom, and there suddenly stopped. I held my breath with all my might and watched intently to see what he would do next. Later I thought, "If only I had this spirit when catching mice." All the force of my concentration gathered in my two eyes, as though my very soul were about to fly out through them. I truly ought to thank this gentleman burglar for granting me an enlightenment I shall never attain again. Suddenly the middle of the third lattice bar of the sliding screen changed color as if soaked by rain; then the paper gradually showed a pinkish tint that deepened and deepened, until before long the paper tore and a red tongue slipped in. The tongue had not remained long before it vanished, and from behind the hole in the paper window there appeared something frighteningly bright. There was no doubt about it: this was the gentleman burglar's eye. What was strange was that the eye seemed not to look at anything else in the room, but to fix itself solely upon me, hidden behind the wicker trunk. Though it did not last long, less than a minute, being stared at like that truly made me feel my life would be shortened by ten years. I could bear it no longer. Just as I was about to spring out from behind the wicker trunk, the bedroom screen slid softly open, and the gentleman burglar for whom I had long been waiting finally stood before my eyes in all his startling presence.

units.source_en: The gentleman burglar's footsteps came as far as the sliding door of the bedroom, and there suddenly stopped.
units.source_zh: 梁上君子的脚步声来到卧室的隔扇前，突然停了下来。

units.source_en: I held my breath with all my might and watched intently to see what he would do next.
units.source_zh: 我拼命屏住呼吸，静观他的下一步动作。

units.source_en: Later I thought, "If only I had this spirit when catching mice."
units.source_zh: 事后我想：“如果我捉老鼠时能以这样的气势那就好啦。”

units.source_en: All the force of my concentration gathered in my two eyes, as though my very soul were about to fly out through them.
units.source_zh: 我那聚精会神的气势，全都集中在两只眼睛上，仿佛我的灵魂一下子要从两眼中飞出去似的。

units.source_en: I truly ought to thank this gentleman burglar for granting me an enlightenment I shall never attain again.
units.source_zh: 我真应该感谢这位梁上君子使我得到了这种再也不会获得的“开窍”。

units.source_en: Suddenly the middle of the third lattice bar of the sliding screen changed color as if soaked by rain; then the paper gradually showed a pinkish tint that deepened and deepened, until before long the paper tore and a red tongue slipped in.
units.source_zh: 那隔扇的第三个窗棂的正中忽然像被雨浸了似的变了颜色，然后窗纸逐渐透成粉红色而且愈来愈浓，很快纸破了，伸进来一条红舌头。

units.source_en: The tongue had not remained long before it vanished, and from behind the hole in the paper window there appeared something frighteningly bright.
units.source_zh: 舌头停了不多久就不见了，从纸窗的孔后边出现了一个怪吓人的发亮的东西。

units.source_en: There was no doubt about it: this was the gentleman burglar's eye.
units.source_zh: 毫无疑问，这就是这位梁上君子的眼睛喽。

units.source_en: What was strange was that the eye seemed not to look at anything else in the room, but to fix itself solely upon me, hidden behind the wicker trunk.
units.source_zh: 奇怪的是，我感到那只眼睛不去看室内其他任何东西，似乎专门注视着藏身在柳条箱背后的我。

units.source_en: Though it did not last long, less than a minute, being stared at like that truly made me feel my life would be shortened by ten years.
units.source_zh: 尽管时间不长，还不足一分钟，但让它这么瞧上一阵子，实在使我感到会少活十年哩。

units.source_en: I could bear it no longer.
units.source_zh: 我再也受不了了。

units.source_en: Just as I was about to spring out from behind the wicker trunk, the bedroom screen slid softly open, and the gentleman burglar for whom I had long been waiting finally stood before my eyes in all his startling presence.
units.source_zh: 当我正要从柳条箱后面蹦出去的当儿，卧室的隔扇被轻轻推开了，我恭候已久的这位梁上君子终于赫然出现在我的眼前。

paragraphs.source_zh: 梁上君子的脚步声来到卧室的隔扇前，突然停了下来。我拼命屏住呼吸，静观他的下一步动作。事后我想：“如果我捉老鼠时能以这样的气势那就好啦。”我那聚精会神的气势，全都集中在两只眼睛上，仿佛我的灵魂一下子要从两眼中飞出去似的。我真应该感谢这位梁上君子使我得到了这种再也不会获得的“开窍”。那隔扇的第三个窗棂的正中忽然像被雨浸了似的变了颜色，然后窗纸逐渐透成粉红色而且愈来愈浓，很快纸破了，伸进来一条红舌头。舌头停了不多久就不见了，从纸窗的孔后边出现了一个怪吓人的发亮的东西。毫无疑问，这就是这位梁上君子的眼睛喽。奇怪的是，我感到那只眼睛不去看室内其他任何东西，似乎专门注视着藏身在柳条箱背后的我。尽管时间不长，还不足一分钟，但让它这么瞧上一阵子，实在使我感到会少活十年哩。我再也受不了了。当我正要从柳条箱后面蹦出去的当儿，卧室的隔扇被轻轻推开了，我恭候已久的这位梁上君子终于赫然出现在我的眼前。
